chapterInfo.content:
17
Odwamamfoɔ kɛseɛ no ne aboa no
1 # Adi 15.1 Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura nkuruwa nson no mu baako bae ne me bɛkasaa sɛ: Bra na menkyerɛ wo odwamamfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔte nsuo pii no soɔ no atemmuo. 2#Adi 14.8; 18.3 Ɔno na wiase ahemfo ne no abɔ adwaman, na n’adwamammɔ nsa no abobo wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no.
3 # Adi 13.1 Na ɔde me faa honhom mu kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. Na mehunuu ɔbaa bi a ɔte aboa kɔkɔɔ a abususɛm din ahyɛ no ma, na ɔwɔ tiri nson ne mmɛn du so. 4#Hes 28.13; 28.16; Yer 51.7 Na ɔbaa no hyɛ atadeɛ afasebire ne nkrawoɔ, na ɔde sika ne aboɔden aboɔ ne nhwene pa ahyehyɛ ne ho, na ɔkura sika kuruwa a akyiwadeɛ ne n’adwamammɔ fi ayɛ no ma. 5#2 Te 2.7; Adi 14.8; 16.19; Dan 4.30 Na wɔatwerɛ din bi ne moma so sɛ: Ahuntasɛm. Babel kɛseɛ no, asase so nnwaman ne akyiwadeɛ na.
6 # Adi 18.24 Na mehunuu sɛ ahotefoɔ mogya ne Yesu adansefoɔ mogya aboro ɔbaa no, na mehunuu no no, ɛyɛɛ me nwanwa kɛse.
7Na ɔbɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Adɛn nti na ayɛ wo nwanwa? Mɛka wo ɔbaa no ne aboa a ɔso no a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn du no ho ahuntasɛm no. 8#Adi 13.1-2; 13.3; 3.5 Aboa a wohunuu no no, da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ, na afei deɛ, ɔnni hɔ, na ɔbɛfiri bunu no mu aba, na wabɛsene akɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu. Na ɛbɛyɛ wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ a wɔamfiri wiase ahyɛaseɛ antwerɛ wɔn din nkwa nwoma mu no nwanwa sɛ, wɔbɛhunu aboa no, sɛ da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ, na afei deɛ, ɔnni hɔ, nanso ɔwɔ hɔ ara. 9#Adi 13.18; 13.1 Ɛha na adwene a nyansa wɔ mu no wɔ. Tire nson no yɛ mmepɔ nson a ɔbaa no te soɔ, na ɛyɛ ahemfo baason. 10Baanum agu, ɔbaako wɔ hɔ, ɔfoforɔ no nnya mmae, na ɔba a, ɛtwa sɛ ɔtena hɔ kakraa bi. 11#Adi 17.8; 19.20 Na aboa a da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ na afei deɛ ɔnni hɔ no, ɔno ara nso ne deɛ ɔtɔ so nwɔtwe, na ɔfiri nson no mu, na ɔkɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu.
12 # Adi 13.1; Dan 7.20; 7.24 Na mmɛn du a wohunuiɛ no ne ahemfo du a wɔnnyaa ahennie, nanso wɔne aboa no bɛnya tumi sɛ ahemfo dɔnhwere baako. 13Yeinom wɔ adwene korɔ, na wɔde wɔn tumi ne wɔn ahoɔden bɛma aboa no. 14#Adi 19.16; 19.14 Yeinom ne Adwammaa no bɛko, na Adwammaa no bɛdi wɔn so nkonim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ awuranom mu Awurade ne ahemfo, mu Hene, — ɔno ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho a wɔafrɛ wɔn na wɔayi wɔn na wɔdi no nokorɛ no.
15 # Adi 17.1; Yes 8.7; Yer 47.2 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsuo a wohunuiɛ a odwamamfoɔ no te soɔ no yɛ nkuro ne nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo ne aman ne kasa ahodoɔ. 16#Adi 17.12-13; 18.8 Na mmɛn du a wohunuiɛ no, ne aboa no, wɔn na wɔbɛtane odwamamfoɔ no, na wɔayɛ no pasaa, na wada adagya, na wɔadi ne nam, na wɔde ogya ahye no. 17#Adi 10.7 Na Onyankopɔn na ɔde ahyɛ wɔn akoma mu sɛ wɔmma ne tiri mu asɛm mmra mu, na wɔnyɛ adwene korɔ, na wɔmfa wɔn ahennie mma aboa no nkɔsi sɛ Nyankopɔn nsɛm no bɛwie duro. 18#Adi 18.10 Na ɔbaa a wohunuu no no ne kuro kɛseɛ a ɛdi asase so ahemfo so hene no.

Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura nkuruwa nson no mu baako bae ne me bɛkasaa sɛ: Bra na menkyerɛ wo odwamamfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔte nsuo pii no soɔ no atemmuo. Ɔno na wiase ahemfo ne no abɔ adwaman, na n’adwamammɔ nsa no abobo wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no.
Na ɔde me faa honhom mu kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. Na mehunuu ɔbaa bi a ɔte aboa kɔkɔɔ a abususɛm din ahyɛ no ma, na ɔwɔ tiri nson ne mmɛn du so. Na ɔbaa no hyɛ atadeɛ afasebire ne nkrawoɔ, na ɔde sika ne aboɔden aboɔ ne nhwene pa ahyehyɛ ne ho, na ɔkura sika kuruwa a akyiwadeɛ ne n’adwamammɔ fi ayɛ no ma. Na wɔatwerɛ din bi ne moma so sɛ: Ahuntasɛm. Babel kɛseɛ no, asase so nnwaman ne akyiwadeɛ na.
Na mehunuu sɛ ahotefoɔ mogya ne Yesu adansefoɔ mogya aboro ɔbaa no, na mehunuu no no, ɛyɛɛ me nwanwa kɛse.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Adɛn nti na ayɛ wo nwanwa? Mɛka wo ɔbaa no ne aboa a ɔso no a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn du no ho ahuntasɛm no. Aboa a wohunuu no no, da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ, na afei deɛ, ɔnni hɔ, na ɔbɛfiri bunu no mu aba, na wabɛsene akɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu. Na ɛbɛyɛ wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ a wɔamfiri wiase ahyɛaseɛ antwerɛ wɔn din nkwa nwoma mu no nwanwa sɛ, wɔbɛhunu aboa no, sɛ da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ, na afei deɛ, ɔnni hɔ, nanso ɔwɔ hɔ ara. Ɛha na adwene a nyansa wɔ mu no wɔ. Tire nson no yɛ mmepɔ nson a ɔbaa no te soɔ, na ɛyɛ ahemfo baason. Baanum agu, ɔbaako wɔ hɔ, ɔfoforɔ no nnya mmae, na ɔba a, ɛtwa sɛ ɔtena hɔ kakraa bi. Na aboa a da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ na afei deɛ ɔnni hɔ no, ɔno ara nso ne deɛ ɔtɔ so nwɔtwe, na ɔfiri nson no mu, na ɔkɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu.
Na mmɛn du a wohunuiɛ no ne ahemfo du a wɔnnyaa ahennie, nanso wɔne aboa no bɛnya tumi sɛ ahemfo dɔnhwere baako. Yeinom wɔ adwene korɔ, na wɔde wɔn tumi ne wɔn ahoɔden bɛma aboa no. Yeinom ne Adwammaa no bɛko, na Adwammaa no bɛdi wɔn so nkonim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ awuranom mu Awurade ne ahemfo, mu Hene, — ɔno ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho a wɔafrɛ wɔn na wɔayi wɔn na wɔdi no nokorɛ no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsuo a wohunuiɛ a odwamamfoɔ no te soɔ no yɛ nkuro ne nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo ne aman ne kasa ahodoɔ. Na mmɛn du a wohunuiɛ no, ne aboa no, wɔn na wɔbɛtane odwamamfoɔ no, na wɔayɛ no pasaa, na wada adagya, na wɔadi ne nam, na wɔde ogya ahye no. Na Onyankopɔn na ɔde ahyɛ wɔn akoma mu sɛ wɔmma ne tiri mu asɛm mmra mu, na wɔnyɛ adwene korɔ, na wɔmfa wɔn ahennie mma aboa no nkɔsi sɛ Nyankopɔn nsɛm no bɛwie duro. Na ɔbaa a wohunuu no no ne kuro kɛseɛ a ɛdi asase so ahemfo so hene no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
